drafts.passage: Gannet achieved higher success rates than Ledger-RNN on unseen layouts from all three training map families (Warehouse: 88.4% vs 81.2%; Office: 85.1% vs 79.6%; Cavern: 79.3% vs 72.5%). This advantage also held on all three held-out map families (Orchard: 71.6% vs 60.3%; Harbor: 68.2% vs 59.4%; Quarry: 64.9% vs 55.1%), indicating that Gannet's benefit generalizes beyond the map families used in training. Gannet also produced shorter mean episode lengths on successful episodes than Ledger-RNN across all six conditions, with differences ranging from 12 to 21 steps. However, no statistical tests were reported, so these differences are descriptive only.
